Job Title: Power BI Developer 
 Location: Redmond WA 
 Duration: Full Time 
 
 Job Description: 
 1. At least 5-7 years of experience in SQL Server specifically in writing queries for processing large datasets. 
 2. Very strong experience in SQL & Excel advance functions. 
 3. Exposure to PowerBI is a plus. 
 4. Ability to develop business intelligent reports in Excel using SQL data. 
 5. Excellent communication skills 6. Self-motivated , self-taught and agile 


 Independent Candidate only
